annotations.title: Signed reference quote for a covered call on TSLAc

description: The latest signed REFERENCE quote for a one week covered call on TSLAc (Coinbase tokenized Tesla stock on Base): spot from the Chainlink feed, realized volatility, strike near 20 delta, premium in basis points, expiry, and how long the quote is valid. A pricing agent signs a new one every 15 minutes. It is a reference price only: not an offer, not advice, not for US persons, and nothing executes from it. The result says whether the signatures checked and whether the quote has expired.

include_signed_bytes.description: Also return signed_payload_canonical, the exact string that was hashed and signed. Default false.

name: get_stock_quote
